summary: Uncommitted corpus-wide chunk.py re-run reverted node-07 cleaning on 1,918 files across 6 traditions, risking silent invalidation of already-reviewed tags/edges
description:
Discovered while scoping a PR for the feat/west-eso-expansion branch's
dossier work (2026-08-18). Not caused by that session's own work.

## What's on disk, uncommitted

`git status` shows 1,918 modified corpus/*.toml chunk files, uncommitted,
spanning six traditions with no relation to each other or to any single
in-progress ingest:

- corpus/egyptian — 453 files
- corpus/neoplatonism — 752 files
- corpus/greek_mystery — 260 files
- corpus/jewish_mysticism — 142 files
- corpus/taoism — 57 files
- corpus/western_esoteric/tertium-organum — 226 files

All are already-committed, already-ingested texts (last touched by "clean
bodies" commits from 2026-07-04 or the tertium-organum add). File mtimes are
2026-08-17, predating this session.

## What changed, and why it's destructive

Sample diff (corpus/egyptian/egyptian-book-of-the-dead-index/chunks/001.toml):

    -body = "...by E. A. WALLIS BUDGE Late keeper ... Antiquities in the British Museum"
    +body = "...by E. A. WALLIS BUDGE Late keeper ... Antiquities in the British Museum [1895] scanned at www.sacred-texts.com, Oct-Dec 2000. Next: Preface"
    -token_count = 74
    +token_count = 98

The body has been reverted from node 07's cleaned state back to node 06's
raw chunk.py output, which is dirty by construction (nav lines, digitisation
credits, "Next:" footers) — exactly the state node 07 exists to strip, and
exactly what node 12's own failure-modes section warns against embedding.

Chunk ids/filenames are stable in the sample (001.toml stays 001.toml,
same 357-file count for the whole egyptian-book-of-the-dead-index work
before and after), so this is not simple renumbering. But the chunk_id is
also the join key for every downstream artifact: for just this one text,
2,252 live EXPRESSES edges and 2,843 staged_tags rows are keyed to chunk
ids whose body text has now silently changed underneath them. A human
reviewer queued those verdicts against specific body text; if the body is
now different, the verdict's grounding claim ("I read this chunk and it
supports this tag") no longer holds, even though nothing in the DB or the
review record shows any change. Multiply by six traditions and this is a
corpus-wide silent-invalidation risk, not a one-text problem.

## Likely trigger

`docs/ingest/03-acquire.md` (also modified, uncommitted, in the same
working tree) documents a real bug found and fixed on 2026-08-17 during the
western_esoteric batch: `fetch_index` in `scripts/downloaders/sacred_texts.py`
was scraping every link on a sacred-texts index page and only excluding
ones with "index" literally in the href, missing header-breadcrumb and
footer Previous/Next-title navigation to *other* works. This leaked one
stray page each into kybalion's and tarot-of-the-bohemians's raw
acquisitions (from Steiner's Knowledge of the Higher Worlds and Waite's
Pictorial Key to the Tarot respectively). The fix was landed (also
uncommitted, in scripts/downloaders/sacred_texts.py + the doc above) and is
legitimate, wanted work — it is NOT part of this ticket's problem and
should ship normally.

The working hypothesis is that verifying/exercising that fix triggered a
`scripts/chunk.py` run scoped too broadly (whole corpus rather than just
the two affected new texts), and node 07 (clean_bodies.py) was never
re-run afterward to restore the cleaned state on the traditions that
re-chunk touched incidentally. This is inference from the state of the
working tree, not confirmed — no session record of the actual commands run
survives to verify it directly.

## What was NOT done

None of the 1,918 files were staged, committed, or discarded. The dirty
working-tree state is exactly as found. The legitimate downloader bugfix
(scripts/downloaders/sacred_texts.py, scripts/chunkers/page_chunker.py if
related, docs/ingest/03-acquire.md) was carried in a separate, scoped PR
and is not blocked on this ticket.

## Two remediation paths (user's framing)

1. **Fix and re-pipeline properly**: diagnose why chunk.py ran corpus-wide,
   scope it correctly to only the texts that actually needed re-acquisition
   under the fixed downloader, then run node 07 (clean_bodies.py) across
   whatever it touched, and reconcile any chunk_id drift against existing
   staged_tags/edges before considering the corpus consistent again.
2. **Make the chunker idempotent against already-processed texts**: adjust
   scripts/chunk.py (or its caller) so a corpus-wide invocation leaves
   chunks unchanged for any text that already has committed, cleaned
   output, and only touches texts explicitly targeted — removing the
   footgun rather than just avoiding it procedurally next time.

## Next step for whoever picks this up

`git diff --stat` against the six affected trees for the exact file list.
`git checkout -- <path>` would silently discard the dirty state without
either the downloader-fix verification or the node-07 re-clean, so don't
default to that without checking whether any of the 2026-08-17 re-chunk
actually needs to be kept (e.g. if it also fixed something real for these
traditions, not just introduced the boilerplate regression).
